issues.title: Supabase Database Storage Driver Unimplemented
issues.description: The 'database' storage driver checks for env variables but fallback-maps all models to in-memory collections, causing complete data loss on server restarts.
issues.recommendedFix: Create Supabase DB clients inside repositories.ts and map memory query filters to Supabase query builders.

issues.title: Plaintext Bearer Tokens Lack Cryptographic Verification
issues.description: Bearer tokens are read directly as string IDs or emails without JWT public-key signature verification, allowing token spoofing in self-serve contexts.
issues.recommendedFix: Integrate Firebase Auth SDK or verify JWT tokens using verifyIdToken routines.

issues.title: Third-Party Connectors Operate in Mock-Only Mode
issues.description: Salesforce, QuickBooks, SkySlope, and Twilio connectors simulate event signal triggers but do not bind to outbound REST endpoints.
issues.recommendedFix: Configure active OAuth routers and REST clients for each connector card.

issues.title: Local Storage Suffers Write Bottleneck Risks
issues.description: STORAGE_DRIVER=local serialize-saves the entire DB structure to a single db.json file on every state change, exposing the system to IO blocks under high load.
issues.recommendedFix: Migrate data storage to relational schemas or document collections.
